eras.name: How It All Started
eras.blurb: The world begins, everything goes wrong, and one family is chosen.

eras.name: Out of Egypt
eras.blurb: Slaves become a nation, get rescued, and are given rules to live by.

eras.name: A Land of Their Own
eras.blurb: They take the land, then keep forgetting God for about 300 years.

eras.name: The First Kings
eras.blurb: The people ask for a king, Saul fails, and David builds a kingdom.

eras.name: Solomon and the Temple
eras.blurb: The richest and wisest king builds the temple, then loses his way.

eras.name: The Kingdom Splits in Two
eras.blurb: One nation becomes two, and prophets warn both until the north is wiped out.

eras.name: Only Judah Left
eras.blurb: The south survives alone for 130 more years, with some good kings and some terrible ones.

eras.name: Jerusalem Falls
eras.blurb: The city and the temple are destroyed, and the people are taken to Babylon.

eras.name: Coming Home
eras.blurb: Persia lets them go home to rebuild the temple, the walls, and the nation.
